name: DOM-AT
summary: DOM-AT, or DOMAT, also known as 5,8-dimethoxy-6-methyl-2-aminotetralin, is a cyclized phenethylamine and 2-aminotetralin related to the psychedelic amphetamine DOM. It is specifically the cyclized 2-aminotetralin analogue of DOM.

pharmacology.text: The compound has been found to be a more potent agonist of peripheral serotonin receptors than DOM in vitro.
